cards.example_en: The cool marble floor felt smooth under my feet.
cards.example_zh: 凉凉的大理石地板踩在脚下很光滑。
cards.explain_zh: 指大理石时不可数；指弹珠时可数。

cards.example_en: The cool marble floor felt smooth under my feet.
cards.example_zh: 凉凉的大理石地板踩在脚下很光滑。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The new tyres made only a marginal difference.
cards.example_zh: 新轮胎带来的变化微乎其微。
cards.explain_zh: 表示变化时指幅度很小，不是完全没有变化。

cards.example_en: The new tyres made only a marginal difference.
cards.example_zh: 新轮胎带来的变化微乎其微。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A stone marker shows where the old road began.
cards.example_zh: 一块石质标记表明旧公路的起点。

cards.example_en: The diagram shows bone marrow inside a long bone.
cards.example_zh: 图示展示了一根长骨内部的骨髓。

cards.example_en: The survey recorded access to maternal healthcare in rural areas.
cards.example_zh: 调查记录了农村地区孕产妇医疗服务的可及情况。

cards.example_en: This puzzle really puts your mathematical skills to work.
cards.example_zh: 这道谜题真能让你运用数学技能。
cards.explain_zh: mathematics是学科名，虽以s结尾但用单数谓语。

cards.example_en: This puzzle really puts your mathematical skills to work.
cards.example_zh: 这道谜题真能让你运用数学技能。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The students entered the values into a matrix.
cards.example_zh: 学生们把数值填入一个矩阵。

cards.example_en: We added shelves to maximize space in our tiny kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 我们加装了架子，以充分利用小厨房的空间。
cards.explain_zh: 及物动词；英式也常拼作maximise。

cards.example_en: We added shelves to maximize space in our tiny kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 我们加装了架子，以充分利用小厨房的空间。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The philosopher asked us what makes a life meaningful.
cards.example_zh: 那位哲学家问我们，什么使人生有意义。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.meaning_zh: 机械修理工；汽车修理工
cards.example_en: The mechanic found a leak under our car.
cards.example_zh: 修理工发现我们的汽车底部有一处泄漏。
cards.explain_zh: mechanic指修理工；mechanics可指力学。

cards.example_en: A mechanical fault stopped our car outside the village.
cards.example_zh: 一处机械故障让我们的车停在了村外。
cards.explain_zh: mechanical指机器相关；mechanic指机械修理工。

cards.example_en: The local media reported on our neighbourhood festival.
cards.example_zh: 当地媒体报道了我们社区的节日活动。
cards.explain_zh: 统称新闻媒体常用the media；单一媒介用medium。

cards.example_en: The media can influence public attitudes by deciding which environmental issues receive the most attention.
cards.example_zh: 媒体可以通过决定重点关注哪些环境问题来影响公众态度。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our neighbour offered to mediate when we argued about parking.
cards.example_zh: 我们因停车问题争吵时，邻居主动提出调解。
cards.explain_zh: mediate侧重促成协议；arbitrate可指作出仲裁。

cards.example_en: A thin membrane separates the two compartments.
cards.example_zh: 一层薄膜将这两个隔室分开。

cards.example_en: Students should understand the pattern rather than merely memorize a rule.
cards.example_zh: 学生应该理解规律，而不只是背熟一条规则。

cards.example_en: Assigning an experienced mentor to each trainee can improve workplace learning and reduce costly mistakes.
cards.example_zh: 为每位受训人员安排一名经验丰富的导师，可以改善职场学习效果，减少代价高昂的错误。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: This old thermometer contains mercury, so handle it carefully.
cards.example_zh: 这支旧温度计含有水银，因此要小心拿放。
cards.explain_zh: mercury指汞，不可数；大写Mercury可指水星。

cards.example_en: Industrial mercury pollution can accumulate in fish and pose serious risks to human health.
cards.example_zh: 工业汞污染可导致汞在鱼体内积累，对人类健康构成严重风险。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The two narrow paths merge just beyond the bridge.
cards.example_zh: 这两条小路在桥的那一头汇合。
cards.explain_zh: merge with表示与……合并；merge into表示并入。

cards.example_en: A messenger arrived with an envelope for the manager.
cards.example_zh: 一名送信人带着一封给经理的信到了。
cards.explain_zh: message 是信息；messenger 是传递信息的人。

cards.example_en: The lesson explains how metabolism converts food into usable energy.
cards.example_zh: 这节课解释新陈代谢如何将食物转化为可利用的能量。

cards.example_en: The writer uses a journey as a metaphor for personal growth.
cards.example_zh: 作者把旅程用作个人成长的隐喻。

cards.example_en: Our tutor explained the methodology before we began our project.
cards.example_zh: 开始项目之前，导师向我们讲解了研究方法。
cards.explain_zh: method是具体方法；methodology侧重整套方法及原理。

cards.example_en: The micro-scale model represents a much larger structure.
cards.example_zh: 这个微尺度模型代表一个大得多的结构。

cards.example_en: We stopped for lunch at mid-day beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 中午，我们在河边停下来吃午饭。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
cards.example_zh: 天气转冷时，这些鸟会向南迁徙。
cards.explain_zh: migrate强调迁移；immigrate移入，emigrate移出。

cards.example_en: These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
cards.example_zh: 天气转冷时，这些鸟会向南迁徙。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We watched the birds during their annual autumn migration.
cards.example_zh: 我们观察了正在进行一年一度秋季迁徙的鸟儿。
cards.explain_zh: migration泛指迁移；immigration侧重迁入。

cards.example_en: The device measures changes smaller than one millimeter.
cards.example_zh: 这个装置能测量小于一毫米的变化。

cards.example_en: The museum displayed a mineral with bright purple crystals.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出了一块带有亮紫色晶体的矿物。
cards.explain_zh: 营养语境中minerals指矿物质，不等于维生素。

cards.example_en: Countries with abundant mineral resources need effective regulations to limit the environmental damage caused by mining.
cards.example_zh: 矿产资源丰富的国家需要有效的法规，以限制采矿造成的环境破坏。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: These plants need minimal care, even during hot weather.
cards.example_zh: 这些植物即使在炎热天气里也只需极少的照料。
cards.explain_zh: minimal 指极少或最低限度，不一定表示完全没有。

cards.example_en: The design aims to minimize energy loss.
cards.example_zh: 这个设计旨在尽量减少能量损失。

cards.example_en: Ten minus three leaves enough apples for everyone.
cards.example_zh: 十个苹果减去三个，剩下的仍够每人分一个。
cards.explain_zh: minus可表减去，也可置于温度前表示零下。

cards.example_en: The article discussed a missile test.
cards.example_zh: 文章讨论了一次导弹试验。

cards.example_en: A skilled designer can make public spaces more accessible to people with limited mobility.
cards.example_zh: 技艺娴熟的设计师能够让行动不便的人更方便地使用公共空间。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: This small modification makes the chair much more comfortable.
cards.example_zh: 这处小改动让椅子舒服多了。
cards.explain_zh: 可数时指具体改动，不可数时指修改过程。

cards.example_en: A mole dug a tunnel beneath the lawn.
cards.example_zh: 一只鼹鼠在草坪下挖了一条隧道。

cards.example_en: The researchers compared the molecular structure of the two substances.
cards.example_zh: 研究人员比较了这两种物质的分子结构。

cards.example_en: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
cards.example_zh: 一个水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

cards.example_en: The recycling campaign gained momentum after several schools joined.
cards.example_zh: 几所学校加入后，回收活动的势头增强了。

cards.example_en: The bank announced a change in monetary policy.
cards.example_zh: 该银行宣布调整货币政策。

cards.example_en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
cards.example_zh: 一只小猴子在我们头顶的树枝间荡来荡去。
cards.explain_zh: monkey通常有尾巴；ape指猿类，通常无尾。

cards.example_en: One company has a monopoly on our island's ferry services.
cards.example_zh: 一家公司垄断了我们岛上的渡轮服务。
cards.explain_zh: 表示对某领域的垄断，常用monopoly on。

cards.example_en: Our family discussed morality after finding a lost wallet.
cards.example_zh: 捡到一个钱包后，我们一家讨论了道德问题。
cards.explain_zh: moral是形容词；morality是名词，常为不可数。
